-- Overlay settings on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.
-- Output order: mode, level, then any other keys in the order given.
-- A repeated key takes its last value.

settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["color"], ["red"]) == ["fast", "3", "red"]
  ex settings(["mode", "mode"], ["a", "b"]) == ["b", "3"]
  var names: List[str] = ["mode", "level"]
  for k in keys
    var seen = False
    for n in names
      if n == k
        seen = True
    if not seen
      names.append(k.copy())
  var result: List[str] = []
  for n in names
    var v = "3"
    if n == "mode"
      v = "fast"
    for i in range(0, keys.len())
      if keys[i] == n
        v = values[i].copy()
    result.append(v)
  result
